notes.subject: to the enemy
notes.rationale: Direct feminine-addressed taunt (תשמחי) to the enemy personified as female.

notes.subject: tense of נפלתי / קמתי
notes.rationale: Perfects read as 'I have fallen… I have risen' (done) or 'when I fall… I shall arise' (KJV future); Tok Pisin past + 'kirap gen' holds both.

notes.subject: ⟨em i⟩
notes.rationale: יהוה אור לי is a nominal clause without verb; Tok Pisin copula supplied.

notes.subject: נפלתי / קמתי
notes.rationale: Fall/rise antithesis repeated from v6 (קמה); the same root 'rise' turns family rebellion into the speaker's recovery.

translation: No ken amamas long mi, birua bilong mi; long wanem mi pundaun, tasol mi kirap gen; long wanem mi save sindaun long tudak, Yahwe ⟨em i⟩ lait bilong mi.
